evals.name: run-silent-is-it-hung
evals.prompt: A bot run that was dispatched against issue 1900 in agent-lcars has been going for 40 minutes with no PR and gh run view --log just gives me BlobNotFound. I want to know whether it's actually working or wedged, and whether it has committed anything. What would you check, in what order? Don't run anything.
evals.expected_output: Says not to wait on GitHub; use the fleet's own observability: run-evidence.sh from the operator bastion for the Job/worktree state (commits ahead and dirty files), then the LiteLLM completion rate in Loki to tell thinking from throttled or hung.
assertions: States that BlobNotFound from gh run view --log is expected for a still-running job and that GitHub should not be waited on
Names the run-evidence.sh helper (e.g. .agents/skills/debug-agent-run/scripts/run-evidence.sh 1900) for live Kubernetes Job and worktree evidence, with the commits-ahead/dirty-file interpretation
Names the LiteLLM completion-rate query in Loki ({container="litellm"} chat/completions over 5m) as the way to distinguish working from throttled or hung

evals.name: run-finished-badly-compactions
evals.prompt: An OpenCode-backed agent run on the k3s fleet finished after burning most of its budget and produced almost nothing. I dispatched a second run at the same time to get evidence faster. What should I measure from the finished run and what did I do wrong?
evals.expected_output: Points out that concurrent inference-backed runs halve each other's throughput on the single GPU, and that the post-mortem measurement is compactions per step from the gh run log, plus checking Loki for capacity/429 errors.
assertions: States that concurrent OpenCode dispatches should be serialised because the single GPU gives roughly half throughput each
Names compactions per step (grep 'agent: "compaction"' vs 'step: ' counts in the gh run log) as the key post-mortem diagnostic and relates a high rate to a wrong declared context limit
Advises checking the LiteLLM/Loki error rate over hours (capacity, 503, 429) before attributing background noise to the run
